title: A/R Summary: the sort stays while changing date, scrolling and filters
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop works at two locations with many customers owing money, and you sort A/R Summary, then change dates, scroll and filter.
  • You are an Admin user (the "Admin" role) working at {Location-A}, your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • The report has more than 30 customers with open documents on today's date and on yesterday's date, at both locations.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has open documents at both locations.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-29 Kept Sort.
  • Starting screen: A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Total" header once.
  2. Change the as-of date to yesterday.
  3. Scroll down until the next 30 customers load.
  4. Open the Customer filter.
  5. Tick {Customer-A}.
  6. In the Location filter, untick {Location-B}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the rows sort by Total, largest first, and the header shows it.
  • Step 2: the report reloads for yesterday and is still sorted by Total, largest first.
  • Step 3: the new rows are still sorted by Total, largest first.
  • Step 4: the Customer menu opens.
  • Step 5: only {Customer-A}'s rows remain, still sorted by Total, largest first.
  • Step 6: only {Location-A} rows remain, still sorted by Total, largest first, and "Total" is still marked as the sorted column (a small arrow beside its heading).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-R7: “The sort is kept while the user stays on the report: changing the as-of date, loading more rows by scrolling, and changing the customer, vendor, Past due or Location filter keep it.”
  • S2-R2: “The first click gives the useful order for the kind of data: text (names, Location, Transaction Type) A to Z; money columns largest first; dates oldest first; Past Due largest first; ID and No. smallest number first (S2-R4). The second click reverses it. The third click repeats the first; there is no unsorted state.”
  • S1-R8: “A/R Summary, A/P Summary, A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices show 30 customers or vendors at a time, and the next 30 load as the user scrolls down, as today. There are no page buttons. A/R Detail and A/P Detail show each bucket's first 100 lines, then load more as the user scrolls (S4-R4). Paging never repeats or skips a customer, vendor or row, in any sort.”
